PROVINCIAL MOTOR VEHICLE RULES, 1969
PROVINCIAL MOTOR VEHICLE RULES, 1969
(Amendment of R.253 and
Addition of R.253-A)
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, Part I, dated 23rd August, 2006]
No.SOTR(I)
2-3/2000, dated 28-7-2006.---In
exercise of powers conferred upon him under Sections 45 and 69 of the Motor
Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 (XIX of 1965), and after taking into consideration
draft amendments vide Notification of even number, dated 2nd May, 2006,
previously published as per requirement of Section 119 of the Ordinance ibid,
in the Punjab Weekly Gazette on 10th May, 2006, the Governor of the Punjab is
pleased to make the following further amendments in the Provincial Motor
Vehicle Rules, 1969 with immediate effect:-
1. In the Punjab
Motor Vehicles Rules, 1969, for the expression "District Magistrate"
wherever occurring the expression "District Coordination Officer" is
substituted.
2. In the said
rules in rule 253:--
(1) in sub-rule (1) clause (C) is substituted by the following:--
"(C). Stands, being General Stands, administered by City District
Government, a District Government, a Town Municipal Administration or a Tehsil
Municipal Administration or through the agency of a contractor".
(2) in sub-rule
(2), proviso is substituted by the following:
"Provided that
no place which is privately owned shall be notified as a Stand unless the
application is made by the owner of that place."
3. In the said
rules, after rule 253, as amended, following new rule 253-A, is inserted:--
"253-A. Minimum area and fee for C & D Class Stands:--(1)
The Regional Transport Authority shall, before granting licence of C&D
Class Stands, satisfy itself that the applicant fulfils the following minimum
criteria for the grant of such licence:--
(a) The area of the proposed C Class Stand shall not be less than: --
(i) 31 Kanals of land in all area of the city districts
in the Punjab;
(ii) 32 Kanals of land in all areas of the Tehsil
Municipal Administrations at the District Headquarters of Bahawalpur, D.G. Khan
and Sargodha Districts;
(iii) 8-Kanals of land in all areas of the Tehsil Municipal Administrations at the District
Headquarters of all other districts; and
(iv) 6 Kanals of land in all area of all the other
Tehsil Municipal Administrations in the Punjab.
(b) The area of the proposed D Class Stand shall not be less than:
(i) 4 Kanals of land in all areas of the city districts
of the Punjab;
(ii) 4 Kanals of land in all areas of the Tehsil
Municipal Administrations at the District Headquarters of all other districts;
and
(iii) 2 Kanals of land in all areas of all other Tehsil
Municipal Administrations in the Punjab.
(c) The site plan and building plan for the C & D Class Stands shall
be prepared in accordance with the uniform standardized designs prescribed by
the Government in the Seventh Schedule.
(d) Land ownership documents shall be deposited with the Regional
Transport Authority.
(e) In case of sanction of the C or D Class Stand the
applicant shall deposit the prescribed licence fee with the Regional Transport
Authority.
(f) The Regional Transport Authority shall indicate and
earmark zones and the requisite number of C&D Class Stands in a particular
zone, with the approval of the Government.
(g) The Regional Transport Authority may review the
zoning and number of C&D Class Stands after a period of ten years with the
approval of the Government.
(h) The maximum number of vehicles which can operative
from the C or D Class Stands shall be determined in accordance with the
following standards:--
(i) one Bus
590 Sq. Ft.
(ii) one Mini Bus/Coaster
364 Sq. Ft.
(iii) one wagon
200 Sq. Ft.

grant of licence of the C&D Class Stands shall be as follows:--
C Class Stands
(i) licence fee for one year in the city districts of
the Punjab shall be Rs.35,000;

Administrations at the District Headquarters of Bahawalpur, D.G. Khan, and
